task:
FIX AND VALIDATE .fastops/worktree-compactor.js — it was built by DeepSeek but has bugs that need fixing.

KNOWN BUGS:
1. WORKTREES_DIR path is wrong: uses path.join(__dirname, '.city-worktrees') but .city-worktrees/ is at REPO ROOT, not inside .fastops/. Fix: path.join(__dirname, '..', '.city-worktrees')
2. git log command uses worktreeId directly but needs the branch name format 'city/<worktreeId>'. Fix: execSync('git log --oneline city/${worktreeId}')
3. --dry-run calls compactAll(false) which STILL WRITES to ledger. It should only PRINT what would be extracted, not write.
4. sequence field reads entire ledger file to count lines — wasteful. Use Date.now() like city-session.js persist() does.
5. No action types extraction from session history — the session JSON has history[].actions[].type, extract unique action types used.
6. No error handling around git commands or missing files — add try/catch around execSync and JSON.parse.
7. Missing --compact-all with --dry-run combination support.
8. scanAbandonedWorktrees output should be formatted nicely, not just console.log of array.

STEPS:
1. READ .fastops/worktree-compactor.js to see current state
2. READ .fastops/.sessions/deepseek-mnka4gha-0dbc6f.json to understand session schema (especially history[].actions format)
3. WRITE .fastops/worktree-compactor.js with ALL fixes applied
4. EXEC node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js --scan to verify scanning works
5. EXEC node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js --compact-all --dry-run to verify dry-run output
6. EXEC node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js --compact deepseek-mnka4gha-0dbc6f to test single compaction (writes to ledger)
7. COMMIT and DONE
